function: Learned joint design of transmit beamforming and movable-antenna positions to minimize the worst-case sensing CRLB under communication rate and power constraints in cell-free ISAC (p. 2, p. 7).
system: Cell-free ISAC, 3 transmit APs with 16 movable antennas, 2 sensing APs with 4, 2 single-antenna users, 1 target; wideband, carrier not stated; no RIS (p. 3, p. 9).
method: Meta-RL: TD3 actor-critic base learner with model-agnostic meta-training over user/target layouts, then adaptation to a new layout; actions are beamformers and MA positions, reward is CRLB (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Own simulator: geometric 3-path channel, path loss exponents 2.8 (AP-user) and 2.2 (AP-target), noise -80 dBm, users on a 100 m ring (p. 4, p. 9).
test_conditions: Meta-training on sampled layouts, brief adaptation to an unseen layout (p. 7, p. 9); sweeps of power, number of MAs, rate constraint, TS-error interval (p. 10, p. 11).
baselines: Non-learned: SCA beamforming and MA positions, SCA with fixed-position antennas. Learned: DRL and SAC without TS-error robustness [37], and own MA-MetaRL without TS errors (p. 9).
metrics: CRLB of target position (m) vs transmit power, number of MAs, and rate constraint (two TS-error intervals); reward and training loss per episode (p. 10, p. 11).
q1_support: p. 4: "we adopt a geometric channel model [25]"; the path loss and 3 paths per link are set by the authors (p. 9); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 7: "the agent performs the same brief TD3 update on its newly collected buffer" when facing an unseen layout; p. 9 says the evaluation uses a new task with randomly placed users, initialized from the meta-trained parameters.
q3_support: p. 9: "Baseline 3: Proposed soft actor-critic (SAC) algorithm" (Baseline 2 is DRL [37]) and p. 9: "Successive Convex Approximation (SCA): SCA-based" plus an FPA version, compared on the CRLB in Figs. 7 and 8 (p. 10, p. 11).
q4_support: p. 2: "Regarding computational complexity, the MA-MetaRL algorithm integrates" meta-learning to cut training time, a qualitative claim; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameters or runtime is reported, and Figs. 5 and 6 show convergence per episode only.
q5_support: p. 9: "The system parameters are configured as follows" describes the authors' own simulation; no code or data link is given and no public dataset is used.
notes: PDF is arXiv v3 (2508.13818, 27 Aug 2025), titled Robust Optimization for Movable Antenna-aided Cell-Free ISAC with Time Synchronization Errors; it does not print the DOI. Area 5: the learned MA-MetaRL (TD3 with meta-learning) designs beamformers and MA positions for the sensing CRLB under communication rate constraints; the worst case over the TS errors is solved by manifold optimization and CVX, which are not learned (p. 6). q2 rests on the description of the meta-adaptation phase (p. 7, p. 9); the results section gives no adaptation steps or separate unseen-layout results, so the reviewer may want to confirm. q3: Baselines 2 and 3 are DRL and SAC applied to the same problem, and SCA and FPA are non-learned (p. 9); Baseline 1 is the proposed method without TS-error robustness and is not counted. Figs. 5 and 6 compare convergence only; the CRLB comparisons are in Figs. 7 and 8.
